story.title: OpenAI adds 'Trusted Contact' safeguard to ChatGPT for users showing signs of self-harm
story.summary: OpenAI has introduced a new safety feature called 'Trusted Contact' that allows ChatGPT users to designate a person who can be notified if their conversations suggest possible self-harm risk. The feature is part of OpenAI's broader effort to make its AI systems safer for vulnerable users, particularly as chatbot usage grows among younger demographics. The opt-in system lets users pre-authorise a trusted person to receive alerts without exposing full conversation content.
